game_intent.json.original_prompt: Create an industrial platformer where I must activate two switches to open a security gate while avoiding patrolling guards and moving machinery. The exit should only become available after both switches are activated.

model_requests.description: Game staged in an industrial factory setting with timed hazards.

model_requests.source: activate two switches to open a security gate
model_requests.description: Two interactable switches linked to a security gate door.
Patrolling guard enemies moving back and forth across platforms.
Moving platforms acting as industrial machinery obstacles.

model_requests.source: exit should only become available after both switches are activated
model_requests.description: Exit door is locked until all required switches are flipped.

model_design.json.title: Industrial Infiltration
model_design.json.premise: Navigate a high-security industrial facility, bypass patrolling guards, ride moving machinery, and flip two control switches to unlock the exit gate.
design_notes: Switches in sections 2 and 5 share the gate ID 'sec_gate' linked to the security door in section 7, ensuring both must be activated before the exit unlocks.
Moving machinery is represented via moving platforms across factory sections.
Patrolling guards use standard stomp combat.
